news.title: mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory allocator for the modern era
news.summary_raw:
mimalloc is an open-source, modern, scalable memory allocator that is a drop-in replacement for malloc and free. It is relatively small (~12K lines), with clear internal data structures, and is easy to build and integrate into other projects. It provides bounded worst-case allocation times (up to OS primitives), bounded space overhead, low internal fragmentation, and minimal contention by relying almost exclusively on atomic operations.
The post mimalloc: A new, high-performance, scalable memory
news.summary: Microsoft Research has open-sourced mimalloc, a high-performance, scalable memory allocator. This provides developers with a modern, drop-in replacement for malloc and free, featuring bounded worst-case allocation times, space overhead, and internal fragmentation.
news.enterprise_use: While not directly impacting your specific IT stack, keep an eye on mimalloc, especially if your team uses or advises on C or C++ development or system programming. This could benefit development efficiency, and you may see it integrated into your existing tech.
